## Summary

Describe the shared or product change.

## Brand bundle

- [ ] `BRAND_VERSION` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when shared files change.
- [ ] App and Docs templates still work from a static server.
- [ ] No product-specific code was added to shared files or generic templates.
- [ ] No external font, icon, or CSS CDN was introduced.

## Accessibility and behavior

- [ ] Skip link and main landmark work.
- [ ] Heading order and landmark structure are logical.
- [ ] Keyboard operation, visible focus, menu behavior, and OS-controlled color mode were checked.
- [ ] Content reflows on a narrow viewport and at 200% zoom.
- [ ] Light/dark contrast and reduced-motion behavior were checked.
- [ ] MarinOS banner is present and the footer contains only `MarinOS`.
- [ ] Feedback is text only, icons are meaningful and decorative, and interface text uses sentence case.
- [ ] WAVE was run over HTTP, or the extension was granted local-page access.

## Consumer impact

- [ ] Upgrade notes identify affected markup, tokens, or behavior.
- [ ] Relevant consumer regression checks are included.
